body.en:
This pack is a **complete** launcher interface in a few files.

- Select an article in the list. The core marks it as read and remembers it.
- Open **Settings** to change persisted values.
- Watch the bottom bar: the core simulates an update before **Play** is enabled.

Read more on the [example website](https://example.com/).

## Changes

1. New map rotation.
2. Faster matchmaking.
3. Fixed the `scoreboard` layout.

> Links work only for hosts in `game.allowed_hosts`: [this one is allowed](https://example.com/patch-2), and [this one is plain text](https://example.org/).
